Practical, beginner-friendly programs designed to launch you into high-paying tech careers.

Available Programmes

Product Management

Master the art of building products people love. 

Learn More

Product Design (UI/UX)

Learn user-centered design and create digital products. 

Learn More

Cybersecurity

Protect businesses from cyber threats 

Learn More

Front End Development

Designs with code to create  websites and apps.

Learn More

Build predictive models that drive business decisions.

Learn More

Backend Development

Power the systems behind every app.

Learn More

AI & Automation

Learn to build smart systems, from chatbots to predictive models.

Learn More

Product & Digital Marketing

 Master the art of positioning and storytelling.

Learn More

Virtual Assistant

Work From Anywhere while supporting businesses.

Learn More

Data Analytics

Turn raw data into million-dollar insights, and tell stories with data.

Learn More

Content Creation

Monetize Your Passion, turn your voice, ideas, profitable career.

Learn More

Software Development

Go from beginner to full-stack developer 

Learn More

Graphics Design

Create compelling visuals for brands, businesses, & platforms.

Learn More

Project Management

Master the skills to plan &lead cross-functional teams

Learn More

Social Media Marketing

Master the art of positioning & storytelling.

Learn More

DevOps Engineering

Master the tools  that make modern software , reliable, and secure.

Learn More

Scholarships Available

Apply for the TS Academy Scholarships and get up to 90% discount on your tuition fees.

Apply Now
